i.norm: Tests that a TSV tokenizer configured with no input (null or empty string) behaves as an empty iterator with zero tokens.
Verifies that the given tokenizer is a distinct instance from the shared CSV and TSV prototype instances — i.e. it is its own copy, not a shared singleton that could be mutated by other callers.
Asserts that the tokenizer contains no tokens and reports the correct empty-iterator state for every navigation method.
A TSV tokenizer created with no input and one created with an empty string must both behave as empty iterators.
